lead: Dinesh Karthik is an Indian cricketer, born on 1 June 1985 in Chennai.
As of 2026, he is 41 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Tamil Nadu cricket team.
This profile collects the Dinesh facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Dinesh Karthik — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Dinesh Karthik was born on 1 June 1985 in Chennai, and holds Indian nationality.
He received his education at St. Bede's Anglo Indian Higher Secondary School and Chettinad Vidyashram.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi and English.

sections.heading: Dinesh Karthik — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists cricketer as his main occupation.

On the team sheet, Dinesh has been associated with India national cricket team (from 2004 to 2010), Tamil Nadu cricket team (from 2002), Delhi Capitals, Punjab Kings (from 2011 to 2011), Mumbai Indians (from 2012 to 2013), Royal Challengers Bengaluru (from 2015 to 2015), Gujarat Lions (from 2016 to 2017) and Kolkata Knight Riders.

sections.heading: Dinesh Karthik — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He is married to Dipika Pallikal (married 2015).
